goal_summary: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the supplied operator. Use Member Inquiry to search by member number for the given member number and select that member. Start a Funds Transfer using the given from-share, to-share, amount, and memo, and click Continue to reach the review screen. On the review screen, before submitting, look at INTERACTIVE ELEMENTS for an element with kind 'hidden' (the security/transaction token) and extract its value using extract_mode=value and internal=true (it must never be a public output). Then click Post Transfer to submit. After the transfer is posted you MUST reach the TRANSACTION COMPLETE confirmation page and look at INTERACTIVE ELEMENTS for a 'cell' element whose name is 'Confirmation' (the posted transaction's confirmation number). Extract its value using extract_mode=value, internal=false, output_name=confirmation_number, output_type=string — this is a genuine result the caller needs and must become a public output, never internal. Only after that extraction has succeeded should you declare the goal DONE, using a suggested_success_condition grounded in stable page text such as TRANSACTION COMPLETE (never the confirmation number or any other value you just extracted).
reason_message: irreversible action requires a human operator
